name: The Meek Mirtho
summary:
The Meek Mirtho is a top-down strategic roguelite. In the demon world, power is everything — and power is earned through fear. You play as Mirtho, a small, harmless demon who has been bullied and cast aside for being “unscary.” But weakness is a matter of perception.

Using your unique talent for manipulation, you escape into the human world to find anxious souls and twist their fears into loyalty. These frightened humans become your army — not through terror, but through wit.

The game blends maze-running and deck-building mechanics. In each wave, you’ll have limited time to explore a grid-based maze, gather followers, and collect scattered equipment (weapons and armor). Equip your human allies to evolve them into new character classes, unlocking them permanently in your collection.

Guide your followers through the gateway to challenge the boss of the wave. Battles unfold as automatic, turn-based card fights, where your preparation determines the outcome. Fail, and your dark little revenge story resets… but your legacy grows stronger with each run.
